reviews.title: Faulty Ram
reviews.comment: Ram was faulty and started causing my PC to constantly crash with memory management errors and lost some of my data.
reviews.author: JosiahS

reviews.title: Ram High Performance
reviews.comment: I have generally purchased Crucial or Samsung RAM, but I was impressed by Best Buy's selection and pricing. I installed these sticks alongside two others, and my PC now delivers excellent performance. The modules feature those shifting lights that really catch the eye. They don't overheat, and they hold up perfectly under the heavy demands of graphic design and medical video editing. I recommend them to everyone.
reviews.author: PedroO
